Divide the sum by expected hours and round down. Unknown hours add no credit. At least 25% severe hours caps the window at 54; any hour capped at 29 caps the window at 79. Commute uses the worse of two journeys. Solar uses the separately stated season-relative radiation ratio. 3 Translate the final score 80-100 is favorable, 55-79 is mixed, and 0-54 is difficult. Unknown hours are not favorable hours. See the exact rules and severity limits for all six lenses 100 * complete daily radiation / valid same-calendar mean radiation. Save the uncapped ratio; the displayed score is its floor clipped to 0-100. No cloud penalty. PV yield is separate and requires complete model inputs, not a climate baseline. pages.title: About | Atlas
pages.visible_text: Record type Daily observation Observed, not forecast Observed period 2026-11-12 Integrity Complete Required observation coverage passed Updated 2026-11-13 18:39 UTC Debrecen, Hungary - 2026-11-12 About This Report What is observed, what is model-derived, and when the daily publication updates. Publication The public report is rebuilt daily from the last complete Europe/Budapest calendar day. It uses the same deterministic calculations as the meteorological analysis, with shorter explanations and fewer diagnostics. Evidence HungaroMet station, radar, LINET and Meteosat products are observational or remotely sensed. Open-Meteo supplies continuous gridded surface fields, model pressure levels and ERA5 climate fields. Optional-source failures are reported as unavailable, never treated as observed zeroes. Climate references "Normal" means the 1991-2020 ERA5 standard reference. The recent-decade comparison and full-record percentile are shown separately.
